# Adekola Emmanuel

Adekola Emmanuel is a creative director, director of photography and
developer based in Abuja, Nigeria. He also works as a cinematographer,
film director, photographer and digital marketer. He is the founder
of Kolimo Multimedia (est. 2014), a full-service creative agency, and has
over 14 years of experience across commercial, documentary, television and
branded productions for clients including UNDP, UN Women, WaterAid,
Transcorp Hilton, oraimo, Haima Health, the Embassy of Israel, the Embassy
of Korea and Bouygues Construction. Kolimo Multimedia was named CEO Network
Under 30s Media of the Year in 2021.

Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/message/MVBLBZS4KHDHF1 (preferred) ·
iamkolimo@gmail.com · +234 813 225 4526 · Abuja, Nigeria

## Selected work

- [Ajeside](https://www.adekolaemmanuel.com/work/ajeside): short documentary on the endangered
  handwoven textile tradition of the Gbagyi people (director of photography).
  Winner of Stories of Rebirth, Threads of Africa 2026, a $25,000 film prize
  awarded by Elevate Africa. Film: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=spmWS3oBUAM
- [The Making of the Madaki](https://www.adekolaemmanuel.com/work/madaki): 2026 short documentary
  on one of Mambilla's most revered traditional titles (director)
- [One Unit](https://www.adekolaemmanuel.com/work/one-unit): 2026 short film for Haima Health on
  voluntary blood donation, World Blood Donor Day (director; a Kolimo
  Multimedia production)
- [The Longest Trip](https://www.adekolaemmanuel.com/work/longest-trip): 2025 short film about
  living with sickle cell (director, director of photography, co-writer)
- [GíríBooks](https://www.giribooks.com): all-in-one business management
  platform he designed and developed
